_meta.definition: The unifying capability across all tables is the management of inventory items, including their descriptions, prices, brands, classes, categories, manufacturers, sizes, formulations, colors, units, containers, and associated operations such as ordering and returns.

columns.name: i_item_sk
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for individual items.

columns.name: i_item_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the i_item_ entity

columns.name: i_rec_start_date
columns.description: Stores the initial sales record date for each item.

columns.name: i_rec_end_date
columns.description: Stores end date (format: YYYY-MM-DD) for item records.

columns.name: i_item_desc
columns.description: Stores descriptive text for various items, often including product names or characteristics.

columns.name: i_current_price
columns.description: Stores current prices for individual items as floating point numbers.

columns.name: i_wholesale_cost
columns.description: Stores wholesale costs for individual items, represented as floating point numbers.

columns.name: i_brand_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the i_brand_ entity

columns.name: i_brand
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of brand names for items, as exemplified by exportischolar #2, amalgamalg #1, etc.

columns.name: i_class_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the i_class_ entity

columns.name: i_class
columns.description: Stores descriptive categories for items, such as pop, dresses, decor, infants, shirts.

columns.name: i_category_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the i_category_ entity

columns.name: i_category
columns.description: Stores descriptive labels for product categories such as Music, Women, Home, Children, Men.

columns.name: i_manufact_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the i_manufact_ entity

columns.name: i_manufact
columns.description: Stores brand names for items, such as 'ableanti', 'esen stable', etc. (up to 50 characters)

columns.name: i_size
columns.description: Stores item size descriptions, such as petite or extra large.

columns.name: i_formulation
columns.description: Stores unique formulation identifiers for items, often including a manufacturer code and product details.

columns.name: i_color
columns.description: Stores item color names up to 10 characters long, such as spring, rosy, sienna, red, pink.

columns.name: i_units
columns.description: Stores descriptive units for items (e.g., Tsp, Bunch, Cup, Tbl, Cup).

columns.name: i_container
columns.description: Stores container type information for items (e.g., box, bottle, can).

columns.name: i_manager_id
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the i_manager_ entity

columns.name: i_product_name
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of product names, such as 'ought', 'able', 'pri', 'ese', and 'anti'.
